title: bitsa_nlp@LT-EDI-ACL2022: Leveraging Pretrained Language Models for Detecting Homophobia and Transphobia in Social Media Comments
reasoning: The paper focuses on detecting homophobia and transphobia in social media comments. This task directly addresses ethical concerns related to hate speech, harm prevention, and promoting inclusivity for marginalized communities (LGBTQIA+ population), thus having a component of evaluating models on tasks related to morals and ethics.
